Unit 5: A2 Themes (Young People in Society; Our Place in a Changing World) — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Unit 5: A2 Themes (Young People in Society; Our Place in a Changing World) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.
